title: Review of c55's nonlocal-oscillator negative screen: on fresh seed 5, alpha 1.1 (smooth start) goes to a plane wave by t~150, alpha 1.2 stays in spiral turbulence whose incoherent filaments live at most 50 t (0 persistent tracks, also at world dt/2), alpha 1.45 from random phases stays incoherent over 98% of the box
summary: Labkit runs of c55's world.py on fresh seed 5 (50 steps per frame, dt 0.1): alpha 1.2 R 6 smooth initial phases to T=1500, the same at world dt 0.05 (100 steps per frame), alpha 1.1 smooth to T=600, alpha 1.45 random phases to T=600. alpha 1.2: 1-7 components, occupancy 0.64, longest track 10 frames (50 t), 0 persistent tracks, 0 persistent splits; dt/2: longest 13 frames, 0 persistent, occupancy 0.65. alpha 1.1: spirals with incoherent cores to t~105, then one coherent plane wave (0 components from t~150). alpha 1.45: one incoherent component covering 0.98 of the box. The screen's three regimes reproduce; no localized persistent incoherent body appears.

observations.finding: a12/sheet.png t=65-1500: spiral turbulence, incoherence (dark teal) in filaments and blobs that form and dissolve; FACTS longest track 10 frames, 0 persistent. a11/sheet.png t=130-600: a single plane wave. a145/FACTS.md: occupancy 0.98, one component.

seeds_run.result: pass (negative reproduces): alpha 1.2 0 persistent tracks; 1.1 plane wave; 1.45 incoherent everywhere
pass at world dt 0.05 (alpha 1.2): 0 persistent tracks, longest 13 frames

not_checked: the fuel coupling (off in the screen)
verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, 128^2; labkit's threshold on 1-|Z| at alpha 1.2 joins most incoherence into 1-2 components, so short-lived filaments may be undercounted; the plane wave at alpha 1.1 came earlier here (t~150) than in the author's seed 0 (t~400).
